label: Wax Lyricist《Flipping In》123 BPM — the animatic proposal, bar 90 cut (✂1) to stay under 175 s

track.title: Flipping In
track.credit: 配乐：Wax Lyricist《Flipping In》（CC0 1.0 公共领域）

plan.why: cold open on the full horn-funk groove; FI 59 ends in a gap and FI 60 lands a hit = the logo pop on 6:1
the track's 2-bar stop (-23/-28 dB, no bass) under the second half of the title card and the H3 match cut
pain: no kick/snare for 12 bars (63-66 hats + bass, 67-74 bass only)
DROP on 21:1 = drums return (FI 75); brass from FI 79 (sb 25); FI 101-102 thin out under M4
the stop again = the wait 「等待本人回应」
payoff out of the stop (+10 dB entry); the full kit returns on FI 105 = sb 53
the song's own drum break (drums only, no bass) = stop-time break
lift: back into the last chorus (thin 103-104, full kit on 105 = sb 77)
end card on the last chorus, faded out under the card

title_stop.note: the stop is FI 61-62 = sb 7-8; the title SLAM on 5:1 lands in the groove (FI 59), the gap at the end of FI 59 + hit on FI 60 meet the logo pop 6:1; SFX impact carries 5:1

pain_sparse.note: no kick/snare from 9:1 to 20:4 (FI 63-74); the bass enters loud on 9:1 (+13 dB after the stop)

drop.note: drums come back on 21:1 (FI 75); a texture change more than a loudness jump (+3 dB)

ai_chime.note: no chime in the track: SFX chime on 31:3

payoff.note: 51:1 enters out of the stop (+10 dB) but FI 103-104 are thin; the full kit arrives on 53:1. flipping-in-b moves the payoff to FI 105

social_groove.note: FI 105-118 is the loudest part of the track

break.note: FI 119-120 drum break (no bass, no horns)

lift.note: 75:1 re-enters the last chorus on its thin bars (FI 103); full kit on 77:1; no key change

end_resolve.note: fade-out from 87:1 under the end card (the track's own ending FI 119-121 is used for the break)
